description: Original modern finite-support reconstruction; not Euler's program or original algorithm.

semantics.atom_bit_order: PQM; atom index = 4*P + 2*Q + M; support bit i marks atom i
semantics.minimal_assumptions_scope: Conjunctions of whole-class P/Q/M nonemptiness only; inclusion-minimal
semantics.dominance_scope: Strict implication over all regime models, with identical figure and premises
